context_requirements: Expression of phospholipase targets (PLCB2/3, PLCD1, PLCG1/2, PLA2G1B) or downstream signaling components
Intact GPCR or RTK signaling to activate phospholipase isoforms
Presence of calcium-dependent signaling machinery for PLC/PLA2 activation
falsifiers: No change in immediate-early genes (FOS, JUN, EGR1) at 6 h in any cell line
No decrease in proliferation markers (e.g., CCND1, MYC) at 24 h
Lack of any transcriptional response across all nine cell lines

changes: Removed all genes from proximal_down: phospholipase activation is not a known direct transcriptional repressor of cell-cycle genes at 6 h; these are generic proliferation effects.
Removed all genes from late_down: sustained phospholipase activation does not directly repress this cell-cycle module; these are generic proliferation effects.
Kept proliferation_down, g1_arrest, and apoptosis only as generic_effects, not as proximal/late gene lists.
